description: Append-only snapshots for one released component. A training row requires a pre-release consensus vintage and a post-release actual vintage.

eligibility_rules.pre_release_consensus: At least one snapshot_at strictly before scheduled_at has a non-null consensus.
eligibility_rules.post_release_actual: At least one snapshot_at at or after scheduled_at has a non-null actual.
eligibility_rules.stable_identity: provider_event_id, component, scheduled_at and reference_period do not change across snapshots.
eligibility_rules.append_only: A duplicate payload is an observation; changed values require a new snapshot and may not overwrite an earlier vintage.
eligibility_rules.rights: Every required right is explicitly true; unknown is failure.
eligibility_rules.time_zone: All timestamps are offset-aware ISO-8601 and normalized to UTC for bundling.
eligibility_rules.simultaneous_release: All components sharing country, currency and scheduled_at are one event bundle.

prohibited_inferences: Do not use file modification time as snapshot_at.
Do not infer a pre-release consensus vintage from a final post-release row.
Do not replace previous with revised when constructing the pre-release state.
Do not treat an official archive fetch in 2026 as historical live arrival time.
Do not allow a research-only or unknown-rights row into a price experiment.
